acquisition.version_qualification: The authenticated render does not expose a separate immutable AutoLab hill-version token. The lock is content-addressed to the captured body. The displayed hills==0.11.0 value is a local evaluator package pin, not treated as the AutoLab hill version.
acquisition.pre_submit_requirement: Re-read the live hill and compare its rules and evaluator contract against this captured body before any final competition submission.

exact_task.object: Exactly n distinct straight Euclidean lines represented by integer triples [a,b,c] for a*x+b*y+c=0.
exact_task.counted_face: A nonzero-area bounded triangular face whose interior is not crossed by any line in the arrangement.
exclusions: A larger triangle subdivided by another line does not count.
A claimed count without an actual geometric arrangement does not count.
An abstract pseudoline arrangement is not a submission.

n.comparison_rule: Scores are compared only at the same n.

baseline.qualification: valid starting point; not claimed best known

local_commands: uv tool run --from hills==0.11.0 hills eval <submission-directory> -H kobon-triangles

campaign_cardinality.note: The authenticated hill page sidebar displayed '7 hills'. The Human Steward clarified that this is a typo and that OPENMATH-2026 contains six hills. No seventh campaign slot is created.

claim_boundary: This record locks the captured Kobon-triangles task and evaluator semantics for research. It does not establish a best-known score, an upper bound, optimality, novelty, competition acceptance, or MATHCERT certification.
